### 
Aadhaar Paperless Offline e-kyc
![expand](https://uidai.gov.in/assets/svgs/AccordionArrow.svg)
What is Aadhaar Paperless Offline e-KYC?
It is a secure sharable document which can be used by any Aadhaar number holder for offline verification of Identification.
An Aadhaar number holder desirous of using this facility shall generate his/her digitally signed Offline XML by accessing UIDAI website. The Offline XML will contain Name, Address, Photo, Gender, DOB, hash of registered Mobile Number,
